referenceLimitations.description: Masked label region is an exclusion, never a hole to model.

referenceLimitations.description: Physical PBR recovery is not appropriate evidence of an emissive composited hologram; material evidence route requires documented applicability.

preSpecAssessment.uncertaintyPolicy: No missing input/behavior blocks authoring a trial spec. Reference uncertainties remain recorded above. Strict schema acceptance never approves trial counts, calibrates camera, or authorizes implementation; human review and render gates remain mandatory.

definitionOfDone: Match the wide layered silhouette, blue core with luminous cap, stepped rectangular frames and multi-contour violet orbit at the reference camera.
Review a neutral structural blockout before colored surfaces or bloom; excluded label pixels do not count as empty object space.
At look-dev preserve dark gaps, denser blue core, subdued rear lines and selective cyan highlights; no polished-glass tower.
All 12 observed details remain explicit geometric or scalar material responsibilities; textureless carriers do not erase grids or contours.

featureGroups.name: Wide layered projected silhouette
qualityCriteria: Match broad orbital footprint and upright stepped frames at 468x360 without using the coarse ROI polygon as exact silhouette.

featureGroups.name: Blue core and closed luminous cap
qualityCriteria: Closed cap overlaps core geometrically by proposed 0.02; blue volume and cap rim remain distinguishable.

featureGroups.name: Independent rectangular projection frames
qualityCriteria: Unequal-height cuboids are siblings of the core under factory root; edge paths and sparse face grids are required at structural pass.
failureModes: all boxes fused or equally tall
independent projections move when only the core is transformed

featureGroups.name: Violet annulus and nearby cyan layers
qualityCriteria: Authored normalized latheProfile creates thin annuli; adjacent contour geometry preserves band width and unequal spacing.
failureModes: default lathe vase due to ignored profile field
thick torus instead of annular band

featureGroups.name: Colored projected volumes with localized detail
qualityCriteria: Matte emissive carriers plus geometric contour/grid layers preserve blue/cyan/violet hierarchy and dark gaps; no invented PBR maps.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not generate code before strict validation and human approval of the source implementation plan.
Preserve macro, meso and micro responsibilities; no one-mesh stand-in for this compound assembly.
All observed details must map to localFeatures, material localOverrides or geometric repetition responsibilities.
Physical attachment contracts apply only to the cap; independently projected layers must not invent sockets or positive overlap to satisfy a gate.
No material is labelled textureless unless its uniform carrier has evidence and every visible pattern remains assigned to separate geometry or per-submesh scalars.
Any later use of sampled texture detail invalidates that carrier's textureless declaration and requires re-review of applicable texture-channel gates.
Never infer physical PBR maps or extraction confidence from this synthetic composite.
Do not advance visual passes from schema validation alone; use reference camera evidence and critical feature scores.
A coarse ROI or label exclusion cannot be used as exact ground-truth silhouette.
